```yaml
name: Version Uploads

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'feature/**'
      - 'release/**'
      - 'hotfix/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-upload:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      deployments: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Determine Version
        id: version
        run: |
          # Extract branch name
          BRANCH_NAME="${GITHUB_HEAD_REF:-${GITHUB_REF#refs/heads/}}"
          # Create a version string based on branch and short SHA
          SHORT_SHA=$(echo $GITHUB_SHA | cut -c1-7)
          VERSION="0.0.0-${BRANCH_NAME//\//-}-${SHORT_SHA}"
          echo "version=${VERSION}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Branch: ${BRANCH_NAME}"
          echo "Version: ${VERSION}"

      - name: Create Deployment Status
        uses: bobheadxi/deployments@v1
        id: deployment
        with:
          step: start
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          env: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          desc: "Version upload for ${{ github.ref_name }} (${{ steps.version.outputs.version }})"
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Upload Version Artifact
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          # Assuming the build output is in 'dist' or similar, package it for upload
          # This is a placeholder for actual version packaging logic specific to sentry-mcp
          tar -czf sentry-mcp-${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}.tar.gz -C dist .
          echo "Artifact created: sentry-mcp-${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}.tar.gz"

      - name: Upload Artifact to GitHub
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sentry-mcp-${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          path: sentry-mcp-${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}.tar.gz
          retention-days: 5

      - name: Update Deployment Status to Success
        if: success()
        uses: bobheadxi/deployments@v1
        with:
          step: finish
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          deployment_id: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.deployment_id }}
          env: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          status: success
          env_url: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
          desc: "Version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }} uploaded successfully"

      - name: Update Deployment Status to Failure
        if: failure()
        uses: bobheadxi/deployments@v1
        with:
          step: finish
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          deployment_id: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.deployment_id }}
          env: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          status: failure
          desc: "Version upload failed"
```
